payload.instruction: Transform raw AP2 outputs into typed findings. Each finding: { nodeId, kind in CB-AUDIT-FINDING-KIND-ENUM, severity in CRITICAL|ERROR|WARN|INFO, message, suggestedAction }. Every finding MUST cite a concrete nodeId or file path. CB-AUDIT-INV-ANALYSIS-BEFORE-FINDINGS requires AP2_ANALYZE = PASS.
payload.expectedOutput: findings: Array<{ nodeId, kind, severity, message, suggestedAction }>
